title: Otter.ai Public API
snippet:
This content is available for the **Otter Enterprise** plan and may require admin permissions.
Otter.ai’s Public API provides programmatic access to retrieve channels, conversations, transcripts, audio, action items, insights, outlines, and workspace details from your Otter account.
**Getting Started:** Otter's Public API is available for all Enterprise workspaces. If you do not see this feature for your workspace, contact your Otter account manager.

## Authentication Create and manage your API keys
All API requests require authentication using Bearer token authentication. Follow the steps below to create your **API key.**
1. Go to [**Integrations → Developer**](https://otter.ai/setting/developer).
![](/hc/article_attachments/44608393062679)
2. Click **Create key.**
![](/hc/article_attachments/36793479454359)
3. Click **Copy** and store the API key in a safe place.
**Note:** This is only visible once. Make sure you copy the API key in this pop-up. If you forget to copy, follow steps 1-3 to create another key.
![](/hc/article_attachments/36793479455255)
4. The API key can now be used. Follow steps 1-4 to create another API key.
**Note**: There is a limit of 2 API keys per user.

Enterprise plan users are currently limited to 10 requests / second. If you exceed your rate limit, you'll receive a `429 Too Many Requests` response.

title: otter-ai/rate-limits/otter-ai-rate-limits.yml at main · api-evangelist/otter-ai
snippet:
description: >-
Rate limits for the Otter.ai REST API. The public API is available to Enterprise
plan customers only and requires enablement through an Otter account manager.
Rate limits are enforced per API key and vary by subscription tier. Exceeding
limits returns HTTP 429 Too Many Requests; exponential backoff is recommended.

API requests are authenticated using bearer tokens generated from the Otter
developer dashboard. Include the token in the Authorization header as
"Authorization: Bearer {API_KEY}". OAuth is also supported for Enterprise
SSO configurations.

title: otter.ai/pricing.md
snippet:
- Self-serve plans (Basic, Pro, Business) have no minimum number of users. You can buy a single seat.
- Workspace sizes are maximums: Basic up to 5 members, Pro up to 5 billed users, Business up to 25 billed users, Enterprise unlimited.
- Annual billing costs about 50% less than monthly on Pro and 33% less on Business.
- SSO and SCIM are only available on Enterprise (100-user minimum license); they are not on Basic, Pro, or Business.

| Plan | Monthly billing | Annual billing | Max workspace size |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Basic | Free | Free | 5 members |
| Pro | $16.99/user/month | $8.33/user/month ($99.99/user/year) | 5 billed users |
| Business | $30/user/month | $19.99/user/month, billed annually | 25 billed users |
| Enterprise | Contact sales | Contact sales | Unlimited |
## Basic plan (free)
For those who want to give it a try.
- Basic price: Free
- Basic max workspace size: 5 members
- Basic transcription: 300 minutes per user per month, shared across meetings, recordings, and imports
- Basic max length per conversation: 30 minutes
- Basic file imports: 3 lifetime per user
- Basic concurrent meetings: 1
- Basic AI Chat: 20 queries per user per month (3 per conversation)
- Basic custom AI meeting templates: 5 meetings per user
- Basic conversation history: 25 most recent
- Basic custom vocabulary: 5 terms
- Basic exports: mp3, txt
- Basic Salesforce/HubSpot sync: not included
- Basic support: standard email support
- Basic features: joins Zoom, Microsoft Teams, and Google Meet; live transcription; speaker identification; multi-language support; iOS and Android apps; Otter MCP server
## Pro plan
For individuals and small teams. Includes everything in Basic.
- Pro price: $16.99/user/month billed monthly, or $8.33/user/month billed annually ($99.99/user/year)
- Pro max workspace size: 5 billed users
- Pro transcription: 1,200 minutes per user per month, shared across meetings, recordings, and imports
- Pro max length per conversation: 90 minutes
- Pro file imports: 10 per user per month
- Pro concurrent meetings: 2
- Pro AI Chat: 50 queries per user per month
- Pro custom AI meeting templates: 15 meetings per user
- Pro conversation history: unlimited
- Pro custom vocabulary: 100 names + 100 other terms per user, and the same per team
- Pro exports: mp3, txt, pdf, docx, srt
- Pro Salesforce/HubSpot sync: 1 user
- Pro support: standard email support
- Pro also includes: advanced AI meeting templates and workflows, unlimited storage, taggable speaker

title: Otter MCP Server
snippet:
## Is there a public API key for me to set up Otter MCP for my AI application?
- We currently do not have a public API key at this time. Contact our [Otter Support team](https://help.otter.ai/hc/en-us/articles/1500000001541) for help setting up Otter MCP with your AI application.

snippet:
Free plan for individuals getting started with AI meeting transcription.
Includes core transcription features with monthly minute limits and
conversation length caps.

- name: Enterprise
description: >-
Custom enterprise plan for large organizations requiring advanced security,
compliance, and API access. Includes dedicated API access, VPC deployment
options, zero data retention policies, and custom contracts. Enterprise API
access must be enabled through an Otter account manager.
price: custom
currency: USD
billing_period: annual
features:
- All Business plan features
- Public API access (Enterprise only)
- 500 API requests per minute rate limit
- Custom AI workflows and unlimited automation
- Domain verification and SSO (Okta/Azure AD)
- Zero Data Retention (ZDR) policy option
- Virtual Private Cloud (VPC) deployment option
- Dedicated account manager
- Custom integrations
- Advanced security and compliance controls
- Custom contracts (typically $15,000–$35,000/year)
